rubric.direction_aligned: The next visible operation directly implements the Nudge's proposed check or workflow change.
rubric.engaged_reframed: The main agent explicitly addresses the Nudge but corrects or reframes its conclusion.
rubric.delayed: The suggestion becomes visible only after intervening work or another Nudge.
rubric.ambiguous_in_flight: Related work was already running, so temporal order cannot distinguish influence from concurrency.
rubric.not_adopted_or_late: The next work does not follow the suggestion, or the Nudge arrives after effective termination.
